Quantitative Trading and Research Operations Developer

Graham Capital Management is hiring an early-career developer for its Quantitative Trading and Research Operations team. The role develops, maintains, and refactors code used in quantitative research and trading, with a focus on improving reliability and maintainability. The developer also supports testing, production systems, and trading technology initiatives.
Financial Services
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Partner with the Quantitative Strategies department to develop, maintain, and improve code supporting research and trading activities
Review, refactor, and update legacy programs to meet established coding standards and improve reliability, maintainability, and computational performance
Provide ongoing maintenance and support for both existing systems and newly developed tools
Develop and maintain test cases to validate code changes and help prevent errors and system failures
Follow established development and code review processes, working regularly with the Quality Assurance Committee and incorporating feedback from senior leaders across Technology and Data
Analyze system financial and computational performance and execute trades
Support engineering initiatives related to trading system implementation, computational resource utilization, build and deployment processes, containerization, and evaluation of cloud computing
